records.entry: INTEL page shows a zoomed map sprinkled with teardrop mission pins
records.notes: Colour is NOT a claimability signal. Earlier project text claimed ORANGE = completed/claimable; the live client contradicts it twice on 2026-09-14: an ORANGE pin at (211,664) opened 大师悬赏：20号 read as INTEL_MASTER_BOUNTY with status BLOCKED (an actionable target, not a reward), and an ORANGE pin at (215,611) opened a Hero Journey card. What each colour encodes is UNKNOWN - do not guess it and do not decide from the colour; decide from the card the brain reads. The pin itself is the only way to learn a mission's identity: the board does not reveal type before a tap. Note also that a card's banner colour can differ from one capture to the next for the SAME mission (a Hero Journey card was read as UNKNOWN at 13:56 and as INTEL_HERO_JOURNEY at 14:00), so a template cropped from one banner colour will not match the other. COLOUR COVERAGE CORRECTED 2026-09-20 (open issue #68). The list above used to be BLUE/PURPLE/ORANGE because `intel_pins.py` only masked those three, so the record described the detector rather than the board. Measured on dataset/truth_audit/reward_popup_exit_20260920/readings/intel_page_20260920T131907.png (720x1280): the board carries GREEN teardrop pins with a white icon at (541,399) and (210,614), and GREY/silver ones at (104,593) and (344,765) -- same teardrop body, same white head icon, same orange base ring as the counted pins, only the body colour differs, and each was confirmed by cropping and looking. The detector returned 4 where 9 markers are present. The false positive to avoid is the page title 情报 itself (grey mask, blob 166x171, fill 0.32 -- the widest and emptiest of the candidates). This is the third instance of the class its own module docstring already records: a detector that silently drops real pins makes a full board read as empty, and the CLEAR_INTEL goal then declares itself complete.

round_state.meaning: 本轮的板子已经打不动了 —— 不是「今天的情报做完了」。agent 必须在下一次刷新后重新检查，不得把这个状态读成 CLEAR_INTEL=COMPLETE 并永久收工。
evidence: learning/episodes.jsonl 2026-09-20T14:45:47Z..14:48:53Z: OPEN_INTEL -> CLAIMABLE(1) -> INTEL_CLAIM_REWARDS -> DISMISS_INTEL_GENERIC_REWARD -> SELECT_INTEL_PIN -> BACK，before.intel = {status: AVAILABLE, pins: 1, untried_pins: 1, stamina: 367, refresh: 01:11:31}
2026-09-20T14:47:45Z SELECT_INTEL_PIN 的 after 是 BLOCKED / mission_type MASTER_BOUNTY / mission_level 20 —— 板上最后一个 pin 开出的是账号打不过的大师悬赏（见 INTEL_MASTER_BOUNTY_20，recommended_power 189295920 对本角色约 1.6M）。
2026-09-20T14:48:53Z BACK 之后 goal_progress 一直是 false，CLEAR_INTEL 因此被判 NO_GOAL_PROGRESS/DEFERRED —— 即「每步都过自己的 verifier 但目标零推进」，这正是操作者看到的「对已清空列表的无意义重复操作」。

next_refresh.note: 倒计时是运行读数，外推只是近似；下一轮必须在情报页重新读一次倒计时，不要拿这个值当排期。

round_state.how_the_loop_must_handle_it: 现有机制已经是对的，不要改成「永久完成」：capability_gate 把 CLEAR_INTEL 判成 DEFERRED（NO_GOAL_PROGRESS，源 READ_INTEL_LIST），而 DEFERRED 走 no_progress_probe_minutes=30 的探测窗，窗口一过自动放行重新观察（实测：模拟时间前进 5 分钟即返回 None=可调度）。所以「等待刷新」是自动的，唯一要防的是把它写死成 COMPLETE。
round_state.untried_pins_is_not_beatability: 注意 untried_pins=1 的含义是「本轮还没点过」，不是「打得过」。那个 pin 本轮点过之后仍留在板上（pin 在任务被消耗后不会消失，见 runtime.py 的 INTEL_PIN 解析器注释），所以它会被反复算作「还有情报」，但开出的是 BLOCKED 任务。这正是本轮 goal_progress 恒为 false 的机制来源。
